name: prism-editor
title: Prism Editor
description: Vector canvas editor: shape tools, layers, transforms, personas. Needs ignition and editor-controls first, StudioUIProvider, @nyc-tron.

prerequisites.reason: Private workspace package (packages/editor-controls) with no tarball. The editor controls moved there from NYC-Tron UI in #95. Do not take them from @nyc-tron/forge/*.
Native host. shadcn copies files and cannot run nitrogen, pod install or CMake (decision 4).
Private workspace package with no tarball. Distribution waits on the versioning scheme (decision 3).

docs:
Needs @nitro-forge/studio-ui-provider (StudioUIProvider) and a host such as nyc-tron-host. Every studio component throws without it. See docs/agent-native/install-order.md step 7.
Needs @nitro-forge/editor-controls first (step 3 of docs/agent-native/install-order.md). shadcn cannot install it.
Needs @nitro-forge/ignition first (step 1 of docs/agent-native/install-order.md). shadcn cannot install it.
Needs @nitro-forge/studio-layout first (step 3 of docs/agent-native/install-order.md). shadcn cannot install it.
